newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia dollar, bonds little moved on data.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia dollar, bonds little moved on data.

text.p: The Australian dollar and bonds were little changed after the November current account widened to A$1.923 billion after a A$1.807 billion deficit in October.
Forecasts had centred on a A$1.75 billion shortfall.
The dollar held at US$0.7906/11, where it stood when the data was released, while the March 10-year bond futures contract was also unchanged from its pre-data level of 92.305.
At the same time, ANZ released its monthly job advertisement data for December. Job ads fell 3.9 percent after a 2.1 percent rise in November.
